opening.argument: The post frames FTX and investors as the subject of a dramatized reaction clip, with a filmed exchange between two men seated outdoors. The dialogue includes “Where is the money, then? Give it to me,” but that line occurs within the exchange; the post does not make a concrete investment, payment, or data-submission offer or direct viewers to send money or join a financial scheme. The visible website and crypto references provide branding and context, not an observable solicitation. Taken together, the title and scene support reading the clip as commentary rather than a request for viewers to act.
